summary: Teaching vector synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. Four sound sources sit at the corners of a diamond (west, east, north, south), a cursor mixes them, four palettes change the sources, and an orbit generator (circle, figure-8, diamond step, random drift) moves the cursor on its own, with an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for evolving pads and textures, or to learn how crossfading four oscillators makes a timbre move.
use_for: A teaching vector synth: evolving pads and textures from four sources at the corners of a diamond, a cursor that mixes them and an orbit that moves it by itself.

parameters.name: Vector X (W-E)
parameters.description: Crossfades horizontally between the West oscillator source (-100%) and the East oscillator source (+100%).
parameters.how: Crossfades horizontally between the West oscillator source (-100%) and the East oscillator source (+100%).
parameters.sound: Sweeps the horizontal timbral balance between warm analog waveforms (West) and glassy digital/FM tones (East).

parameters.name: Vector Y (S-N)
parameters.description: Crossfades vertically between the South oscillator source (-100%) and the North oscillator source (+100%).
parameters.how: Crossfades vertically between the South oscillator source (-100%) and the North oscillator source (+100%).
parameters.sound: Sweeps the vertical timbral balance between deep sub/pad foundations (South) and airy choir/noise textures (North).

parameters.name: Corner Palette
parameters.description: Loads curated 4-oscillator combinations into the N/S/E/W corners (`Poly Classic`, `Cinema Horizon`, `Cyber Pulse`, `Organic Hybrid`).
parameters.how: Loads curated 4-oscillator combinations into the N/S/E/W corners (`Poly Classic`, `Cinema Horizon`, `Cyber Pulse`, `Organic Hybrid`).
parameters.sound: Changes the four underlying sound sources being blended by the X-Y pad.

parameters.name: Orbit Rate
parameters.description: Controls the speed of the vector trajectory generator that automatically moves the cursor around `(vector_x, vector_y)`.
parameters.how: Controls the speed of the vector trajectory generator that automatically moves the cursor around `(vector_x, vector_y)`.
parameters.sound: Determines how slowly or rhythmically the 4 sound sources morph into one another.

parameters.name: Orbit Depth
parameters.description: Sets the radius of the automated 2D movement around the manual X-Y center point.
parameters.how: Sets the radius of the automated 2D movement around the manual X-Y center point.
parameters.sound: At 0% the mix stays fixed where you place the cursor; at 100% it sweeps all four corners continuously.

parameters.name: Orbit Path
parameters.description: Selects the geometric trajectory of the automated vector motion (`Circle`, `Figure-8`, `Diamond Step`, `Random Drift`).
parameters.how: Selects the geometric trajectory of the automated vector motion (`Circle`, `Figure-8`, `Diamond Step`, `Random Drift`).
parameters.sound: Changes the rhythmic pattern and symmetry of the evolving timbral crossfades.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
